subject: Stability incidents prompting expansion discussion with FinLogix
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@finlogix.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: alyssa.cheng@finlogix.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting checkout — need plan

Hi Priyom,

We had another set of tail-latency spikes overnight that caused roughly 12% of our conversion flow to time out. The app retries masked some of it, but our ops team is flagging this as a blocker for the renewal conversation next month.

I attached the trace/latency rollup from our incident window for context. Can you help explain root causes and give us options for preventing recurrence? Our renewal is planned for 2026-10-05 and the execs are pushing for a path that guarantees stability.

Short ask: can Redwood commit to a higher SLA or an availability-focused pilot for the last-mile production traffic? If so, what are the terms and lead time?

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Engineering
FinLogix

Attachment: latency_report_q3.csv (CSV diagnostics, 1.2MB)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlogix.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting checkout — need plan

Samir — thank you for the data and the heads up. I'm very sorry for the disruption; we take incidents like this seriously. Quick notes from our side after an initial look:

- The spikes align with a mix of larger-than-usual batched requests plus a small subset of long-context sessions that exceeded our preferred KV-cache window.
- No security event; this looks like workload distribution + cache miss amplification.

Immediate options we can propose:
1) Dedicated pilot: route your critical traffic to a small dedicated pool (1-2 instances) running an SLA addendum (higher uptime SLO + priority scheduling). Lead time: ~2 weeks.
2) Routing + fallback policy: keep you on hosted but pin a lower-latency model variant for checkout routes and enable a fast fallback on overload. Lead time: ~3 days.
3) Credits + remediation: if we miss agreed targets during the trial, we can provide service credits and a postmortem with mitigations.

I've looped Ben (Sales Engineering) and Lauren (Customer Success) to scope commercial and deployment details. If you want, we can run a short canary next week to validate the dedicated route and produce a formal SLA addendum.

Next step: propose a 30-minute technical + commercial sync. Are you available Tue 2026-09-14 10:00 PT?

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

---
Original attachment preserved: latency_report_q3.csv

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@finlogix.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting checkout — need plan

Priyom / Lauren — quick internal notes ahead of the sync:

- Commercial framing: FinLogix is mid-market but growing quickly; this renewal is strategic. We should avoid an across-the-board discount; instead offer an accelerated path to a Dedicated pilot + a 12-month SLA addendum at a modest uplift.
- Pilot scope suggestion: 3-week dedicated pilot for checkout traffic with performance targets (p90 latency < 120ms, p99 < 450ms) and an automated rollback if we exceed error thresholds.
- Pricing: propose a usage uplift + a 20% pilot fee credit applied to first 3 months of Dedicated if we meet targets.
- Legal/procurement: Lauren, we will need a quick addendum template (SLA + credits + termination for repeated breaches). Also want a clause for capacity precedence during the pilot window.

I'll draft the commercial bullet points and the numbers; Priyom, if you can confirm the pilot sizing requirements from Samir during the call, we can send a short addendum the same day.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_sla_addendum_v1.pdf (Draft, 4 pages)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlogix.com>, priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting checkout — need plan

Samir — thanks again for the frank call today. Summary and agreed next steps: 

1) Pilot: FinLogix will run a 3-week Dedicated pilot for checkout traffic starting 2026-09-22. Scope: routing of checkout endpoints only (~120 req/s steady, 400 req/s peak), p90/p99 targets as above.
2) SLA addendum: Redwood will issue a one-page SLA addendum reflecting the pilot SLOs, credit triggers, and capacity precedence. Ben to circulate final draft by EOD 2026-09-16.
3) Commercials: Pilot pricing will be billed at a pilot rate; if SLOs met, Redwood will apply a 20% credit to the first three months of a Dedicated commitment. If not met, FinLogix receives proportional credits per the addendum.
4) Escalation & reporting: Weekly health reports during the pilot and an incident owner from Redwood (Ben) with 24h response SLA.
5) Signatures: We'll send the addendum via DocuSign for a quick exec sign-off. Expected final sign-off by 2026-09-30 to keep the 10/05 renewal cadence.

Please reply here to confirm and I'll get the DocuSign packet ready.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0123
